integrity.source_access_notes: The closest projective Brownian manuscript was materially inspected; some generic comparison sources were accessible only as abstracts.

scientific_limitations: Only isotropic Fubini–Study Brownian motion with fixed diffusion coefficient across dimensions is covered.
The target-scaled limits are sequential; no uniform simultaneous dimension/target limit is claimed.
The order is in Laplace-transform sense, not pathwise or usual stochastic order.
Finite computations do not certify the infinite asymptotic statements; an analytical proof is supplied.
The underlying Jacobi diffusion and standard CIR/Kummer first passage transform are prior work; a broader unlocated Jacobi comparison may cover aspects.
title: Haar-scale fidelity hitting: strict dimension ordering and a Bessel-to-exponential clock
